reuse.why: Replaces the three copied category queries with one getFillableCategories, but copyPreviousMonth keeps its own path through getBudgetData plus separate templated/fixed sets, and the fixed-group rule is never folded into the shared selection.

duplication.why: The '#fixed' skip ('if (fixed.has(cat.id)) continue') and the income/tracking guard are repeated in all six month-wide actions, and copyPreviousMonth re-implements the hidden and saved-template exclusions that getFillableCategories does in SQL.

placement.why: The selection helpers live in budget/actions.ts next to the actions that use them and the new handler is registered in budget/app.ts like its siblings; the exclusion rule is split between SQL in the helper and loops in each action.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions, the new handler, tests and release notes.

maintainability.why: 'Which categories may a month-wide action write' is answered in three places in three forms (SQL filter, Set lookups in each loop, a separate path in copyPreviousMonth), so the next exclusion will have to be added to every action again.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts does not use getFillableCategories and applies the hidden and template rules itself through getCategoriesWithSavedTemplates and its own hidden check.

disguised_duplication.where: The saved-template rule appears as a SQL clause in getFillableCategories and as a Set from getCategoriesWithSavedTemplates in copyPreviousMonth, and the hidden rule as a SQL ternary in the helper and as an if-condition in copyPreviousMonth (budget/actions.ts).

abstraction_drift.where: getFillableCategories (budget/actions.ts) gains includeHiddenCategories with a hiddenFilter ternary; copyPreviousMonth bypasses it, and the #fixed rule is applied outside it at setZero, set3MonthAvg, set6MonthAvg, set12MonthAvg and setLastMonthSpending.
